title: Pixels with a stride
hints: Pixel `(x, y)` is at `pixels + y * stride + x`. Using `width` instead of `stride` is exactly the bug the tests look for.
Clip by working out the left, top, right and bottom edges of the overlap with `std::max` and `std::min`. `fillRect` then becomes "take the clipped sub-view and fill all of it".
